title: Topological order, and the cycle you have to report
why: Reporting the cycle instead of an empty array is the difference between a useful build tool and a hung one, and it is the part an implementation tends to skip.
requirements: Write `src.js` exporting `topoSort(nodes, edges)` where `nodes` is an array of ids and `edges` is an array of `[from, to]` pairs. Return an array with every node once, each node after everything it depends on. Independent nodes keep the order they had in `nodes`. If a cycle exists, throw an `Error` whose message contains `cycle:` and the ids that are stuck. If an edge names an id that is not in `nodes`, throw an `Error` whose message contains `unknown node` rather than ignoring the edge. No dependencies.
